whitepaper.label: Technical Whitepaper
whitepaper.placeholderNote: This is a generic whitepaper template. Final content to be supplied by the project team.

ai-framework.overview: The Next-Gen AI Application Framework is a modular, open-source runtime for building context-aware, multimodal AI applications at scale. (Placeholder content.)
ai-framework.architecture: The framework consists of a context engine, a multimodal router, and a pluggable tool layer. Detailed architecture diagrams will be added in the final revision.
ai-framework.roadmap: Q1 2026: context engine beta. Q2 2026: multimodal router GA. Q3 2026: ecosystem grant track launch.
ai-framework.team: Core contributors include Foundation-affiliated researchers and external grantees. Full roster to be published.

video-protocol.overview: The Intercontinental Low-Latency Video Player Protocol is a peer-to-peer media protocol designed for sub-second cross-continental streaming. (Placeholder content.)
video-protocol.architecture: The protocol layers a relay mesh over WebRTC, with adaptive bitrate negotiation and reputation-weighted peer selection.
video-protocol.roadmap: Q1 2026: cross-continental relay expansion. Q2 2026: protocol specification v1. Q3 2026: third-party interoperability tests.
video-protocol.team: Led by Foundation senior researchers with cross-disciplinary expertise in streaming, networking, and cryptography.

self-organizing-net.overview: The Decentralized Self-Organizing Network is an autonomous mesh routing layer capable of self-healing and reconfiguration without central coordination. (Placeholder content.)
self-organizing-net.architecture: Nodes discover peers via gossip, compute routes via a modified AODV variant, and signal health via on-chain attestations.
self-organizing-net.roadmap: Q1 2026: testbed deployment in 3 regions. Q2 2026: peer-reviewed milestone report. Q3 2026: public testnet.
self-organizing-net.team: Research-led by Foundation senior researchers in distributed systems, with external academic collaborators.
